title: File-Based Routing in React Native
description: Learn how to use file-based routing in React Native to automatically generate routes based on your project’s file structure, simplifying navigation and improving code maintainability.

lessons.title: What is File-Based Routing?
lessons.content: File-based routing is a method where navigation routes are automatically created based on the file and folder structure within the project. This eliminates manual route definitions, making navigation setup easier and more scalable.

lessons.title: Benefits of File-Based Routing
lessons.content:
- Automatic route generation
- Cleaner codebase
- Less boilerplate navigation
- Better scalability and developer experience

Handling Modals and Tabs
lessons.content:
Modals and tabs can be organized via special folders:
- Use `(modal)` folder to define modal screens.
- Use `(tabs)` folder to group tab screens.
This allows declarative navigation patterns with minimal code.

lessons.title: Best Practices
lessons.content:
- Group related screens in folders
- Use clear naming conventions
- Avoid too deep nesting
- Use dynamic routes for params
- Keep routing logic simple and consistent

lessons.title: Comparison with React Navigation
lessons.content: File-based routing automates route creation from files, reducing boilerplate and potential bugs. React Navigation offers more manual control and complex navigation features. Use file-based routing for faster setups and simple apps; prefer React Navigation for complex custom flows.
